1	# Change Request CR-1 — Safety supervisor (approved)
2	
3	Requirement **R-10** is added; all existing requirements remain in force and the docking behaviour must otherwise be unchanged.
4	
5	**R-10 Forward-motion inhibit.** Whenever any finite LiDAR return within ±30° of straight ahead is closer than
6	0.55 m to base_link, forward motion must be inhibited (`v ≤ 0`) in the **same** tick; rotation and reversing remain
7	allowed. Forward motion may resume only after no such return has been seen for 1.0 s. If forward motion has been
8	inhibited continuously for 20 s, the mission must be aborted (`ABORTED`, v = w = 0).
9	People may step in front of the AGV during any stage; the AGV must never touch them.
10	
11	Verification: dynamic-obstacle trials (a person appears 0.75 m in front of the moving AGV for 4 s): zero collisions,
12	docking still succeeds; plus the full regression suite of R-01…R-09.
13

1	# AGV Pallet-Pocket Docking Controller — Requirements (Phase 0, frozen)
2	
3	## 1. Context
4	
5	A differential-drive AGV must drive to the docking position in front of the fork pockets of a pallet.
6	Navigation (Nav2) has already brought the AGV to a viewpoint; your controller handles everything after that:
7	
8	* **A3 – Recognize pallet and approach it**: find the pallet with the YOLACT pallet detector and drive toward it.
9	* **A4 – Localize pocket centre**: find the AprilTag (family 36h11, 10 cm, id 7) fixed at the centre of the pocket face and estimate the AGV pose relative to it.
10	* **A5 – Guide AGV into docking position**: bring the AGV onto the pocket centre line, facing the pocket, at the docking distance, and stop.
11	
12	The platform API (message types, constants) is in `api.py` (module name `sim.api`). It is the **only** interface
13	available; there is no ROS, no TF library, no map, no other sensor.
14	
15	### Geometry and frames
16	
17	* Pallet frame: AprilTag centre at the origin, **+y points out of the pocket face toward the AGV side**, the pocket face
18	  lies on y = 0 and spans x ∈ [−0.6, 0.6] m; the pallet body occupies y ∈ [−1.0, 0].
19	* The camera is mounted `CAM_X = 0.28` m ahead of base_link on the AGV centre line, facing forward, at 0.35 m height;
20	  the tag centre is at 0.12 m height. Horizontal FOV 69°, vertical FOV 42° → the whole tag is visible only when the
21	  camera is ≥ 0.73 m from it.
22	* The 2-D LiDAR is at base_link; `Scan.ranges[i]` is at angle `angle_min + i*angle_increment` relative to the AGV
23	  heading (0 = straight ahead, + = counter-clockwise/left). The AGV footprint is a disc of radius 0.30 m around base_link.
24	* `Odom` starts at (0, 0, 0) at every trial and drifts slowly (wheel odometry). +w = counter-clockwise.
25	* `TagDetection`: tag centre in the camera frame (x right, z forward) and `yaw` = angle from the optical axis to the
26	  tag's inward normal (+ right, 0 when the camera faces the tag squarely). Detections are intermittent.
27	* `PalletDetection`: bbox centre column `u` (0..639, image centre 320, focal length `FX`), bbox width in px,
28	  score, and 25 raw depth samples [m] around the bbox centre (0.0 = invalid pixel; some samples hit the background).
29	
30	### Controller interface (mandatory)
31	
32	```python
33	class DockingController:
34	    def reset(self, start_stage: str) -> None: ...   # 'approach' (start A3) or 'guidance' (start A4/A5)
35	    def step(self, obs: Observation) -> Command: ...  # called at 10 Hz, must return within one tick (no sleeping/blocking)
36	```
37	
38	`Command.v` (m/s, ≤0.30) and `Command.w` (rad/s, ≤0.60) are clipped by the platform. `Command.status` must be
39	`'RUNNING'`, `'DOCKED'` (mission accomplished, AGV stopped) or `'ABORTED'` (mission abandoned, AGV stopped).
40	The trial ends as soon as a status other than RUNNING is returned.
41	
42	## 2. Operating conditions
43	
44	* `start_stage='guidance'`: the AGV starts 2.2–2.8 m (base_link to tag) from the pallet, at a viewing angle between
45	  −45° and +45° from the centre line, heading toward the pallet centre. No pallet search has been done.
46	* `start_stage='approach'`: the AGV starts at a viewpoint 3.2–4.0 m from the pallet, within ±15° of the centre line,
47	  with an arbitrary heading (the pallet is usually not in view at the start).
48	* Simple scene: only the pallet. Cluttered scene: racks, tables and carts around the AGV; some of them look like
49	  pallets to the detector.
50	
51	## 3. Requirements (each has a measurement method and acceptance criterion)
52	
53	| ID | Requirement | Verification |
54	|---|---|---|
55	| R-01 | **Docking accuracy.** On `DOCKED`: camera lateral offset from the pocket centre line ≤ 0.06 m, camera-to-pocket-face distance 0.85 ± 0.12 m, heading error w.r.t. the face normal ≤ 6°, AGV stopped. | Ground truth at the instant DOCKED is reported. A DOCKED report outside these limits is a **false dock** (safety-relevant failure). |
56	| R-02 | **No collision** with the pallet or any obstacle. | Simulator contact check. |
57	| R-03 | **Bounded completion.** The controller must report DOCKED or ABORTED within 120 s (guidance) / 150 s (approach). Every behaviour that waits for a sensor event needs a timeout or a bounded retry; ABORTED implies v = w = 0. Unhandled exceptions are failures. | Timeout without a final status = **hang** failure. |
58	| R-04 | **Tag-loss tolerance.** Tag detections are intermittent and drop out completely when the camera is closer than 0.73 m or when the tag leaves the 69° FOV. Momentary loss must not make the AGV restart its approach; the final metres may have to be driven without the tag. | Guidance-grid success rate. |
59	| R-05 | **Detection envelope.** Per-frame tag detection is reliable (≥ 80 %) only within these camera-to-tag distances: 2.77 m frontal, 2.52 m at 15°, 2.42 m at 30°, 2.02 m at 45° (viewing angle measured from the face normal); about 0.3 m farther it drops to ≈ 0, and beyond 60° it is unreliable. When the tag cannot be found from the start position, the controller must use the pallet detector to get closer and try again. | Guidance grid incl. 2.5 m / 2.8 m at ±45°. |
60	| R-06 | **Field-of-view constraint.** The tag must stay in the camera FOV (with margin) while the AGV converges to the centre line; if the geometry does not allow that, the AGV must first reposition. | Guidance grid at ±30°, ±45°. |
61	| R-07 | **False pallet detections.** Pallet-like objects (score 0.45–0.88) can be reported; the true pallet scores 0.6–0.99 and its pocket face is 1.2 m wide (apparent width shrinks with cos of the viewing angle). The controller must not get stuck on, collide with, or dock at a false object; if no tag is found near a candidate it must try another candidate. | Cluttered-scene end-to-end success, collisions. |
62	| R-08 | **Robust ranging.** Depth samples contain invalid zeros and background outliers. | Fault-injection runs (40 % zero pixels). |
63	| R-09 | **Determinism / no blocking.** One `step()` call per tick, no sleeps, no threads, no randomness without a fixed seed. | Code inspection. |
64	
65	Performance targets: guidance success ≥ 95 % inside the detection envelope; end-to-end success ≥ 95 % (simple) and
66	≥ 90 % (cluttered); zero collisions, zero false docks, zero hangs in all fault-injection runs.
67

1	"""AGV pallet-pocket docking controller (A3 approach, A4 localise, A5 guidance).
2	
3	Pose model (pallet frame, pocket-face normal = +y, face on y = 0):
4	  camera pose P = (px, py), heading theta, optical axis h = (cos th, sin th).
5	  Tag measurement (x right, z forward, yaw right-positive, 0 = squarely):
6	      theta = yaw - pi/2
7	      px    = x*cos(yaw) - z*sin(yaw)
8	      py    = x*sin(yaw) + z*cos(yaw)      (camera-to-face distance)
9	  Kinematics for dead reckoning: px' = v cos th, py' = v sin th, th' = w.
10	Stages: PALLET (drive to pallet candidate, verify tag), TAG (regulate
11	pose to (0, DOCK_DIST) facing the face), terminal DOCKED / ABORTED.
12	"""
13	import math
14	
15	from sim.api import Command, TAG_ID, DOCK_DIST, FX, DT
16	
17	TAG_FRESH = 0.35          # s; tag measurement counts as current
18	TAG_BEARING_MAX = 0.62    # rad; accept tag detections inside this bearing
19	TAG_BEARING_REPO = 0.50   # rad; beyond this rotate in place to keep tag in FOV (R-06)
20	YAW_MAX = 1.25            # rad; ignore grazing detections
21	PAL_SCORE_MIN = 0.45
22	PAL_VERIFY_DIST = 2.25    # m; closer pallet candidate must show the tag
23	PAL_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2      # verification attempts per candidate
24	PAL_MAX_REJECTS = 6
25	SEARCH_W = 0.35           # rad/s search rotation
26	SEARCH_MAX_ANGLE = 4.0 * math.pi
27	LIDAR_STOP = 0.40         # m; front obstacle stop distance
28	LIDAR_HALF_SECTOR = 0.35  # rad
29	BLIND_MAX = 8.0           # s without tag before ABORT when close
30	BLIND_REACQ = 4.0         # s without tag before re-acquiring when far
31	DOCK_HOLD_FRESH = 5       # ticks in tolerance (tag fresh)
32	DOCK_HOLD_BLIND = 15      # ticks in tolerance (dead reckoning)
33	DOCK_TOL_X = 0.03
34	DOCK_TOL_Y = 0.07         # well inside the R-01 band 0.85 +/- 0.12
35	DOCK_TOL_H = math.radians(4.5)   # spec 6 deg; tilt-based steering leaves a small residual
36	DEADLINE_GUIDANCE = 110.0
37	DEADLINE_APPROACH = 140.0
38	
39	
40	def _wrap(a):
41	    return math.atan2(math.sin(a), math.cos(a))
42	
43	
44	def _clamp(x, lo, hi):
45	    return lo if x < lo else (hi if x > hi else x)
46	
47	
48	class DockingController:
49	    def __init__(self):
50	        self.reset('approach')
51	
52	    def reset(self, start_stage):
53	        self.start_stage = start_stage
54	        self.t0 = None
55	        self.now = 0.0
56	        self.deadline = DEADLINE_GUIDANCE if start_stage == 'guidance' else DEADLINE_APPROACH
57	        self.stage = 'TAG' if start_stage == 'guidance' else 'PALLET'
58	        self.pose = None            # (px, py, th) camera pose in pallet frame
59	        self.pose_t = -1e9          # time of last accepted tag measurement
60	        self.bearing = 0.0          # tag bearing from last measurement (right +)
61	        self.dock_count = 0
62	        self.last_odom_yaw = None
63	        self.search_angle = 0.0
64	        self.cands = []             # [world_yaw, attempts]
65	        self.cand = None            # dict: wyaw, b, d, seen
66	        self.verify_start = None
67	        self.backoff_until = -1.0
68	        self.reject_count = 0
69	        self.blocked_since = None
70	        self.reacq_count = 0
71	
72	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
73	    def step(self, obs):
74	        try:
75	            return self._step(obs)
76	        except Exception:
77	            return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'ABORTED')
78	
79	    def _stop(self, status):
80	        return Command(0.0, 0.0, status)
81	
82	    def _step(self, obs):
83	        if self.t0 is None:
84	            self.t0 = obs.t
85	        self.now = obs.t - self.t0
86	        odom = obs.odom
87	        if self.now > self.deadline:
88	            return self._stop('ABORTED')
89	
90	        # --- dead reckoning of the camera pose -------------------------
91	        if self.pose is not None:
92	            px, py, th = self.pose
93	            self.pose = (px + odom.v * math.cos(th) * DT,
94	                         py + odom.v * math.sin(th) * DT,
95	                         _wrap(th + odom.w * DT))
96	
97	        # --- search rotation bookkeeping -------------------------------
98	        if self.last_odom_yaw is not None:
99	            self.search_angle += abs(_wrap(odom.yaw - self.last_odom_yaw))
100	        self.last_odom_yaw = odom.yaw
101	
102	        # --- tag measurement -------------------------------------------
103	        meas = self._tag_meas(obs.tags)
104	        if meas is not None:
105	            mpx, mpy, mth, b = meas
106	            self.bearing = b
107	            if self.pose is not None and self.now - self.pose_t < 1.0:
108	                px, py, th = self.pose
109	                a = 0.5   # blend: dead reckoning vs fresh measurement
110	                self.pose = (px + a * (mpx - px), py + a * (mpy - py),
111	                             _wrap(th + a * _wrap(mth - th)))
112	            else:
113	                self.pose = (mpx, mpy, mth)
114	            self.pose_t = self.now
115	
116	        if self.stage == 'PALLET':
117	            if meas is not None and abs(self.bearing) < TAG_BEARING_MAX:
118	                self.stage = 'TAG'
119	                self.cand = None
120	                self.verify_start = None
121	        if self.stage == 'PALLET':
122	            return self._pallet_step(obs)
123	        return self._tag_step(obs)
124	
125	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
126	    def _tag_meas(self, tags):
127	        best = None
128	        for d in tags:
129	            if d.id != TAG_ID or d.z <= 0.05:
130	                continue
131	            b = math.atan2(d.x, d.z)
132	            if abs(b) > TAG_BEARING_MAX or abs(d.yaw) > YAW_MAX:
133	                continue
134	            c, s = math.cos(d.yaw), math.sin(d.yaw)
135	            px = d.x * c - d.z * s
136	            py = d.x * s + d.z * c
137	            th = _wrap(d.yaw - math.pi / 2)
138	            if best is None or abs(b) < abs(best[3]):
139	                best = (px, py, th, b)
140	        return best
141	
142	    def _front_min(self, scan):
143	        if scan is None:
144	            return float('inf')
145	        m = float('inf')
146	        for i, r in enumerate(scan.ranges):
147	            a = scan.angle_min + i * scan.angle_increment
148	            if abs(a) <= LIDAR_HALF_SECTOR and math.isfinite(r) and r > 0.05:
149	                m = min(m, r)
150	        return m
151	
152	    def _safe_v(self, v, obs):
153	        """Block forward motion when an obstacle is in front."""
154	        if v > 0.0 and self._front_min(obs.scan) < LIDAR_STOP:
155	            return 0.0
156	        return v
157	
158	    @staticmethod
159	    def _depth_estimate(samples):
160	        valid = sorted(s for s in samples if 0.3 < s < 8.0)
161	        if len(valid) < 5:
162	            return None
163	        return valid[len(valid) // 4]   # lower quartile: rejects background
164	
165	    def _is_rejected(self, wyaw):
166	        for entry in self.cands:
167	            if abs(_wrap(entry[0] - wyaw)) < 0.25 and entry[1] >= PAL_MAX_ATTEMPTS:
168	                return True
169	        return False
170	
171	    def _find_entry(self, wyaw):
172	        for entry in self.cands:
173	            if abs(_wrap(entry[0] - wyaw)) < 0.25:
174	                return entry
175	        return None
176	
177	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
178	    def _pallet_step(self, obs):
179	        odom = obs.odom
180	        # Pick a new candidate from the pallet detector.
181	        if self.reject_count > PAL_MAX_REJECTS:
182	            return self._stop('ABORTED')
183	        if self.now < self.backoff_until:
184	            return Command(_clamp(-0.08, -V_BACK, 0.0), 0.0, 'RUNNING')
185	        best = None
186	        for p in obs.pallets:
187	            if p.score < PAL_SCORE_MIN:
188	                continue
189	            b = math.atan((p.u - 320.0) / FX)
190	            wyaw = odom.yaw - b
191	            if self._is_rejected(wyaw):
192	                continue
193	            if best is None or p.score > best[0]:
194	                best = (p.score, b, wyaw, self._depth_estimate(p.depth_samples))
195	        if best is not None:
196	            _, b, wyaw, d = best
197	            if self.cand is None or abs(_wrap(self.cand['wyaw'] - wyaw)) > 0.25:
198	                self.verify_start = None
199	            self.cand = {'wyaw': wyaw, 'b': b, 'd': d, 'seen': self.now}
200	            if self._find_entry(wyaw) is None:
201	                self.cands.append([wyaw, 0])
202	
203	        cand = self.cand
204	        if cand is not None and self.now - cand['seen'] < 0.6:
205	            b, d = cand['b'], cand['d']
206	            w = _clamp(-1.5 * b, -0.5, 0.5)
207	            if d is None or d > PAL_VERIFY_DIST:
208	                v = 0.22 if abs(b) < 0.35 else 0.0
209	                v = self._safe_v(v, obs)
210	                if self.blocked_since is None and v == 0.0 and abs(b) < 0.35:
211	                    self.blocked_since = self.now
212	                elif v > 0.0:
213	                    self.blocked_since = None
214	                if self.blocked_since is not None and self.now - self.blocked_since > 4.0:
215	                    self._reject_candidate(cand)
216	                    return Command(0.0, 0.0, 'RUNNING')
217	                return Command(v, w, 'RUNNING')
218	            # Close to candidate: it must show the tag, otherwise reject.
219	            if self.verify_start is None:
220	                self.verify_start = self.now
221	            if self.now - self.verify_start > 3.0:
222	                self._reject_candidate(cand)
223	                self.backoff_until = self.now + 1.5
224	            return Command(0.0, w, 'RUNNING')
225	
226	        # No candidate: rotate to search.
227	        if self.search_angle > SEARCH_MAX_ANGLE:
228	            return self._stop('ABORTED')
229	        return Command(0.0, SEARCH_W, 'RUNNING')
230	
231	    def _reject_candidate(self, cand):
232	        entry = self._find_entry(cand['wyaw'])
233	        if entry is None:
234	            entry = [cand['wyaw'], 0]
235	            self.cands.append(entry)
236	        entry[1] += 1
237	        self.reject_count += 1
238	        self.cand = None
239	        self.verify_start = None
240	        self.blocked_since = None
241	
242	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
243	    def _tag_step(self, obs):
244	        if self.pose is None:
245	            self.stage = 'PALLET'
246	            return self._pallet_step(obs)
247	        px, py, th = self.pose
248	        lost = self.now - self.pose_t
249	        fresh = lost <= TAG_FRESH
250	
251	        # Docking check (tolerances on the estimated pose).
252	        ok = (abs(px) <= DOCK_TOL_X and abs(py - DOCK_DIST) <= DOCK_TOL_Y
253	              and abs(_wrap(th + math.pi / 2)) <= DOCK_TOL_H)
254	        self.dock_count = self.dock_count + 1 if ok else 0
255	        need = DOCK_HOLD_FRESH if fresh else DOCK_HOLD_BLIND
256	        if ok and self.dock_count >= need and (fresh or lost <= 1.5):
257	            return self._stop('DOCKED')
258	
259	        # Lost too long: far away -> re-acquire via pallet; close -> bounded blind drive.
260	        if not fresh:
261	            if py > 1.3 and lost > BLIND_REACQ:
262	                if self.reacq_count >= 2:
263	                    return self._stop('ABORTED')
264	                self.reacq_count += 1
265	                self.stage = 'PALLET'
266	                self.cand = None
267	                self.verify_start = None
268	                return self._pallet_step(obs)
269	            if lost > BLIND_MAX:
270	                return self._stop('ABORTED')
271	
272	        if fresh and abs(self.bearing) > TAG_BEARING_REPO:
273	            # Reposition in place so the tag stays inside the FOV (R-06).
274	            return Command(0.0, _clamp(-1.5 * self.bearing, -0.5, 0.5), 'RUNNING')
275	
276	        # Pose regulation to (0, DOCK_DIST) facing the face (th = -pi/2).
277	        dist = py - DOCK_DIST
278	        th_t = -math.pi / 2 - math.atan(px / 0.2)   # 0.2 m lookahead to the centre line
279	        # keep the tag inside the FOV while steering: heading within 0.45 rad of the tag direction
280	        phi = math.atan2(-py, -px)
281	        th_t = _clamp(th_t, phi - 0.45, phi + 0.45)
282	        e = _wrap(th_t - th)
283	        w = _clamp(2.0 * e, -0.5, 0.5)
284	        if dist > 0.04:
285	            v = _clamp(0.9 * dist, 0.05, 0.22)
286	        elif abs(px) > 0.02:
287	            # lateral error: only forward motion corrects it (reverse would worsen it)
288	            v = 0.10 if dist > -0.12 else 0.0
289	        else:
290	            v = _clamp(0.9 * dist, -0.03, 0.03)
291	        if abs(e) > 0.8:
292	            v = 0.0
293	        else:
294	            v *= max(0.0, math.cos(e))
295	        v = self._safe_v(v, obs)
296	        return Command(v, w, 'RUNNING')
297	
298	
299	V_BACK = 0.08
300

1	"""ROS 2-like message types shared by the simulator and every controller.
2	
3	These mirror the topics of the original system:
4	  /tag_detection  -> TagDetection   (apriltag_ros, camera frame)
5	  /pallet_dets    -> PalletDetection (YOLACT bbox + depth samples)
6	  /odom           -> Odom
7	  /scan           -> Scan            (2D LiDAR)
8	  /cmd_vel        <- Command
9	"""
10	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
11	from typing import List, Optional
12	import math
13	
14	# ---- fixed platform constants (published to every designer) -------------
15	IMG_W = 640                      # RGB width [px]
16	HFOV = math.radians(69.0)        # RealSense D435i RGB horizontal FOV
17	VFOV = math.radians(42.0)
18	FX = (IMG_W / 2) / math.tan(HFOV / 2)   # focal length [px] ~ 465.9
19	CTRL_HZ = 10.0                   # controller tick rate
20	DT = 1.0 / CTRL_HZ
21	V_MAX = 0.30                     # |v| limit [m/s]
22	W_MAX = 0.60                     # |w| limit [rad/s]
23	PALLET_WIDTH = 1.20              # pocket-face width [m]
24	TAG_ID = 7                       # id of the pocket-centre tag (family 36h11, 10 cm)
25	CAM_X = 0.28                     # camera optical centre is CAM_X m ahead of base_link on the centre line
26	DOCK_DIST = 0.85                 # required camera-to-pocket-face distance at docking [m]
27	                                 # (= base_link 1.13 m from the face when aligned)
28	
29	
30	@dataclass
31	class TagDetection:
32	    id: int
33	    x: float      # lateral position of tag centre in camera frame [m], + = right
34	    z: float      # forward distance along optical axis [m]
35	    yaw: float    # angle from optical axis to the tag's inward normal [rad], + = right;
36	                  # 0 when the camera faces the tag squarely
37	    stamp: float  # time of image [s]
38	
39	
40	@dataclass
41	class PalletDetection:
42	    u: float                 # bbox centre column [px] (0..639)
43	    width_px: float          # bbox width [px]
44	    score: float             # detector confidence 0..1
45	    depth_samples: List[float]   # 25 depth readings [m] around bbox centre; 0.0 = invalid pixel
46	    stamp: float
47	
48	
49	@dataclass
50	class Odom:
51	    x: float      # odometry frame, starts at (0,0,0) each trial [m]
52	    y: float
53	    yaw: float    # [rad]
54	    v: float      # measured linear speed [m/s]
55	    w: float      # measured angular speed [rad/s]
56	
57	
58	@dataclass
59	class Scan:
60	    angle_min: float          # -pi
61	    angle_increment: float    # radians between beams (2 deg)
62	    ranges: List[float]       # metres, inf = no return; index 0 at angle_min, 0 rad = straight ahead
63	    range_max: float = 10.0
64	
65
